01 / mix[flow]

Hear the parts.

mix[flow] separates audio locally into drums, bass, vocals and other instruments. Play the stems and adjust their levels.

Explore mix[flow] ↗

02 / set[flow]

See the whole set.

A session manager for Ableton Live. Work with your clip grid, mixer and device chain, and organize songs in your Live set.

Explore set[flow] ↗

03 / visual[flow]

Give the set
a visual language.

A VJ rig that reads your Live set. Build visuals with a graph of connected nodes and keep time with Ableton Link.

Explore visual[flow] ↗

About open[flow]

Different parts
of the process.

open[flow] is a family of music tools. set[flow] and visual[flow] work with Ableton Live through a shared bridge. mix[flow] works with audio locally, on its own.
